headline: Nevish Line Swaps Hands as Callahans Passage Churns Under Fire
war_summary: Combat has reignited along the western and central sectors over the past three hours, led by a sharp resurgence of tactical turnover in Nevish Line, where five base transitions unfolded across Grief Mother and neighboring redoubts. In Callahan's Passage, violent skirmishing surged to claim over twenty-five hundred casualties within two hours, punctuated by a base contest at the wire around the Crumbling Passage. Weathered Expanse witnessed a critical realignment as remaining Warden garrisons were dislodged, leaving six bases under Colonial control and three reduced to unoccupied ruins amid steady bombardment. Meanwhile, Stonecradle registered fresh territorial friction with late captures around Trammel Pool, reducing the Warden footprint there to a single redoubt. By contrast, the volatile flashpoints of the previous edition have quieted noticeably: base turnover in Palantine Berm halted entirely during the past two hours, and the bitter fighting around The Wind Hills in Mooring County has ceased, leaving Warden garrisons in steady possession. Stlican Shelf and Linn of Mercy continue to endure steady attrition, but frontline positions there remain physically unchanged.
